title: Experiment to omit page labels for destinations without page-number links
candidate_change: Keep every named PDF destination. Emit a LaTeX label only for anchor targets referenced by the page-link macro; direct destinations without page-number links retain their clickable hypertarget.

candidate.pdf_structure_review: Not performed; the production helper completed all three compilations and its convergence and layout-log checks.

comparison.decision: Reject: the candidate is slower in these runs and produces a larger LaTeX source. The measurements do not establish a performance benefit.

limitations: Baseline and candidate runs were each repeated three times on the same environment, but were not interleaved.
N=1000 was used only to count destinations and page-reference targets; no N=1000 PDF was compiled with this candidate.
The benchmark fixture uses synthetic data and 96x72 pixel portraits.
